title: Contact maturity extension - elementary frictionless penalty qualification

scope.driver: common nonlinear residual and tangent assembly

requirements.name: Gap and unilateral activation
requirements.evidence: open and penetrating node-to-triangle states with signed gap and active-set details
requirements.policy: record signed gap; g>0 is open and g<0 is active penetration

requirements.name: Common nonlinear driver
requirements.evidence: nonlinear static contact solve with contact residual and tangent diagnostics
requirements.policy: contact is assembled by the common Newton path; no contact-specific global driver

requirements.name: Equilibrium and convergence observability
requirements.evidence: relative residual, iterations, active contacts, gap and contact tangent sparsity
requirements.policy: record-only in Lot 1; Owner release band remains open

requirements.name: Penalty sensitivity
requirements.policy: penetration trend must be non-increasing; conditioning/production band requires Owner review

requirements.name: Open-close-recontact path
requirements.evidence: load path [0.25, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0] with expected active sequence [false, true, false, true]
requirements.policy: all transitions are recorded; no finite-sliding claim

requirements.name: Excessive penetration failure contract
requirements.evidence: controlled penetration-limit violation raises structured contact failure
requirements.policy: fail closed; no converged verdict for an invalid contact state

requirements.name: Determinism and finite outputs
requirements.evidence: replay comparison and recursive finite-value audit
requirements.policy: exact deterministic replay for the controlled case; NaN/Inf is failure

requirements.name: Bounded limitation traceability
requirements.evidence: machine-readable scope, case mapping and evidence manifest
requirements.policy: unsupported physics is explicit and cannot be counted as PASS

out_of_scope: contact qualification for elements beyond the Lot 1 TET4 case
